entities.summary:
Operation True Promise I, Iranian retaliatory strikes against Israel on 13 April 2024, was a pivotal event in the arc of Middle Eastern geopolitics. This series of airstrikes, which took place in Iraq, marked a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict between Iran and Israel. The operation was carried out in response to a perceived Israeli threat to Iranian interests and demonstrated the increasing tensions between the two regional powers.

The core events of Operation True Promise I were a series of airstrikes launched by Iran against Israeli targets in Iraq. The operation began on 1 April 2024 and lasted for 13 days, ending on 14 April 2024. The airstrikes resulted in significant damage to Israeli military installations and equipment, and multiple casualties were reported. The operation was widely condemned by the international community, with many countries calling for restraint and de-escalation.

The legacy of Operation True Promise I is one of increased tensions and instability in the Middle East. The operation has set back efforts to normalize relations between Iran and Israel and has emboldened hardline elements within both countries. The operation's impact will be felt for years to come, as the ongoing conflict between Iran and Israel continues to pose a significant threat to regional and global security.

One striking consequence of Operation True Promise I is the significant escalation of tensions between Iran and Israel. As the situation continues to unfold, it remains to be seen whether this operation will mark a turning point in the ongoing conflict or merely a temporary setback in the pursuit of peace.
